handoff.purpose: Define _queue_repo_path helper and work_queue_candidates function for validating and extracting candidates from a work queue source.

symbols.name: _queue_repo_path
symbols.note: Validates and normalizes a repo-relative path string; raises WorkQueueInvalid on any deviation.

symbols.name: work_queue_candidates
symbols.note: Validates an entire daedalus-work-queue/1 source and yields candidates for ready tasks; fail-closed on malformed ready tasks.

claims.text: Validation is whole-file and fail-closed: one malformed ready task makes the source invalid instead of silently shortening the operator's queue.
claims.why: The loop raises WorkQueueInvalid on any validation failure for ready tasks (e.g., missing id, invalid state, missing instruction), so a single malformed ready task causes an exception, making the source invalid.

claims.text: Non-ready tasks are valid records but are not candidates.
claims.why: When state != 'ready', the code increments non_ready and continues without adding to candidates list.
Code checks `if not isinstance(repo_state, Mapping): raise WorkQueueInvalid(...)`.

claims.text: repo_state.head must be a full 40- or 64-hex candidate base revision
claims.why: Code uses `_SHA_RE.fullmatch(base_revision)` to validate it matches the pattern for 40- or 64-hex SHA.
Code checks `if not isinstance(tasks, list): raise WorkQueueInvalid(...)`.

observations.what: Function _queue_repo_path validates path against repo_root using _confined_path (not shown) and returns canonical relative posix path.
work_queue_candidates imports load_policy inside a conditional block, which may cause late import errors.
Variables observed_head, queue_sha, queue_path are assigned but not used in the shown chunk; they may be used later in the function.
Policy variable is assigned but never used in this chunk; may be used later.
